newsitem.headline: EP CIVIL LIBERTIES COMMITTEE AGENDA - SEPT 9.

text.p: Committee on Civil Liberties and Internal Affairs [[ Monday 09 September 1996 ]] 1. Adoption of draft agenda (PE218.466 ) 2. Approval of minutes of meetings of: - 16 April 1996 (PE218.451 ) - 24 and 25 April 1996 (PE217.998 ) - 10 and 11 June 1996 (PE217.995 ) - 18 June 1996 (PE218.458 ) - 8 and 9 July 1996 (PE218.459 ) ===] In the presence of the Council and Commission 3. Chairman's announcements ===] From 3.15 to 5 p.m.: 4. PUBLIC HEARING on minimum guarantees for asylum procedures - Experts invited: - Mr Pieter BOELES, Netherlands, lawyer in Amsterdam and adviser to the Netherlands Government - Mr Friedrich LOPER, FRG, Ministerial Adviser in the Federal Ministry of Home Affairs - Mr Johannes VAN DER KLAAUW, Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees, Brussels ===] At 5 p.m.: 5. 1997 budget - Section III (T04556) (T04556) BUD0074 COM(96)0300 C4-0350/96 + LIBE Avis A HAARDER Bertel. (ELD) (PE218.457 ) F BUDG Fond R BRINKHORST Laurens J (ELD) (PE218.328 ) - Exchange of views on the draftsman's draft opinion and draft amendments 6. Joint resolution by the Committee on Budgetary Control and the Committee on Civil Liberties and Internal Affairs resulting from the joint oral questions by the two committees on the state of the ratification of the Convention on the Protect ion of Financial Interests - Adoption of motion for a resolution 7. Interparliamentary conference on combating fraud against the Community budget (T04884) INI0504 INI0504 + LIBE Avis L

(PE218.456 ) F CONT Fond R THEATO Diemut. (PPE) (PE218.049 ) - Vote on and adoption of draft opinion in letter form 8. On-the-spot checks and monitoring by the Commission for the detection of frauds against EC financial interests (T04630) CNS95358 COM(95)0690 C4-0115/96 + LIBE Avis A BONTEMPI Rinaldo. (PSE) (PE218.465 ) F CONT Fond R THEATO Diemut. (PPE) (PE218.052 ) - Vote on and adoption of draft opinion in letter form 9. Additional protocol to the Convention on protection of the Communities' financial interests (legal persons' liability) (T04757) CNS95360 COM(95)0693 C4-0137/96 + LIBE Fond R BONTEMPI Rinaldo. (PSE) (PE218.453 ) - Initial exchange of views on draft report 10. Any other business 11. Date of next meeting - 17 September 1996 in Strasbourg (to be confirmed) - 25 and 26 September 1996 in Brussels END OF DOCUMENT.
